caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a candle holder shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The main body of the candle holder resembles a large, broad leaf with visible veins, colored in rich shades of brown and deep red with hints of purple. The candle socket, centrally positioned on the leaf, is circular and bordered by a gold or brass ring with a ribbed texture. The handle extends from one side of the leaf, organically shaped with flowing, twisted patterns and colored in matching brown tones. The side view below the top view shows the candle holder supported by three small feet, with the leaf form and candle socket both visible, and the handle arching outward. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color, and the lower right corner includes small printed text indicating “ACTUAL 3/4 SIZE” and “Fireside supervision.”
title: Candlestick
